description: Provider-owned execution gates, distinct from MCEG scientific Assessments.

gates.scope: Included atomic/continuum identities, hydrogenic cross-section anchors, independent mixing quadrature, finite differentiable rates and implicit charge feedback.
what_not_proved: Atomic-data accuracy, complete hydrogen atom, or H-minus chemical equilibrium.

gates.scope: The prescribed-rate six-state API and observer-ray population path retain their prior behavior after the generic charge-solver refactor.
what_not_proved: This is a regression of the retained Huang/Seaton closure, not an endorsement of that closure over the new finite-atom PSM20 choice.

gates.scope: Provider receipt integrity, retained-reference replay, malformed-run handling, complete case coverage and readiness policy.
what_not_proved: Synthetic tool tests establish bookkeeping behavior; they do not replace actual Cloudy executions.

gates.scope: Static Eddington moment transport: analytic limits and exact discrete energy exchange.
what_not_proved: Exact angular transport, external stellar beam, moving-medium or partial redistribution accuracy.

gates.scope: Finite inflow reactive-flow branch, variable mu, chemical energy, advection, independent IVP convergence and implicit derivatives.
what_not_proved: Transonic mass-flux selection or the joint internally irradiated atmosphere.

gates.scope: Selected coupled radiation/population roots at prescribed density and temperature.
what_not_proved: Prescribed density/temperature roots; no thermal, flow or atmospheric accuracy is inferred.

gates.scope: Joint thermal, atomic and radiation balance with the declared energy convention.
what_not_proved: Sampled static root only; no uniqueness, thermal stability or full-atmosphere validation.

gates.scope: Shared spherical radiation and advecting material energy budget.
what_not_proved: One short subsonic inflow experiment; no transonic selection.
Boundary-budget error is normalized by carried radiation flux; exchange_budget_error separately exposes cancellation relative to the small net material exchange.

gates.scope: Matched spatial and frequency refinements of the joint calculation.
what_not_proved: One short joint-flow spatial sequence and one equilibrium frequency sequence; not a global error bound or an observational tolerance.
Atom-size physical adequacy is a separate gate and is not inferred from numerical grid convergence.

gates.scope: Implicit derivatives against independent finite differences at converged joint roots.
what_not_proved: Selected equilibrium cross-cell and finite-flow density derivatives only; no posterior convergence, identifiability or global smoothness.

gates.scope: At T=9000 K, nH=1e12 cm^-3, Trad=10000 K and W=0.025, n3 changes by at most 5 percent from nmax=4 to 5.
what_not_proved: Passing numerical tests does not imply this accuracy gate passes.
Even passing this comparison would not prove convergence to an infinite atom.

gates.scope: For the extended nmax=20 atom at T=9000 K, nH=1e12 cm^-3, Trad=10000 K and W=0.025, continuum refinement and forward/reverse implicit population derivatives meet numerical tolerances.
what_not_proved: Numerical accuracy does not establish shell-size convergence or atomic-data accuracy.
The derivative checks use log(T) and log(nH) at one declared baseline, not a global NUTS parameter domain.

gates.scope: At T=9000 K, nH=1e12 cm^-3, Trad=10000 K and W=0.025, both n2 and n3 change by at most 5 percent from nmax=15 to 20. The explicit 5,10,15,20 sequence is also retained.
what_not_proved: The original nmax=4-to-5 criterion remains separate and is not redefined by this gate.
This sampled larger-atom criterion does not prove infinite-atom convergence, agreement with an external reference, or atmospheric validity.

gates.scope: Controlled optically thin pure-H T9000K, nH1e12cm^-3, Trad10000K, W0.025 finite-atom comparison against Cloudy23.01 with retained diagnostic-only patches.
what_not_proved: Atomic kernels deliberately differ; this is external-model adequacy evidence, not same-equations solver verification.
No full-atmosphere, thermal-equilibrium, transonic, angular-transport or KELT-9b validation.
Cloudy input, raw outputs, failures, convergence checks and reporting-only patch are retained separately and integrity checked.
